title: Surface-Induced Conformational Changes of alpha-Synuclein on Silica Nanoparticles of Varying Sizes Corresponding to Protein Structural Domains: Insights from Enhanced Sampling MD Simulations.
authors: Gong, Shuai; Ma, Yu; Liu, Hongyi; Shen, Lei
journal: Langmuir : the ACS journal of surfaces and colloids
one_liner_zh: 该文用增强采样MD模拟研究α-突触核蛋白(IDP)在不同尺寸二氧化硅纳米颗粒表面的构象变化，虽对象为IDP且用物理模拟方法，但互作对象是纳米颗粒而非蛋白-蛋白互作，机制建模思路对IDP构象调控有参考价值。
abstract: Protein-nanoparticle interactions are crucial in a diverse array of biotechnology and biomedical applications. Variations in nanoparticle sizes can adjust surface interactions with proteins and biomolecules, thereby influencing their conformation and functionality. To achieve precise control over the nanoparticle sizes corresponding to the dimensions of protein structural domains ( approximately nm) and establish the relationship between nanoparticle curvature and protein conformational changes, we conduct well-tempered metadynamics simulations to explore the secondary structure changes and thermodynamic characteristics of alpha-synuclein (alphaS), an intrinsically disordered protein (IDP), adsorbed onto silicon dioxide (SiO(2)) nanoparticles of varying sizes (diameter, d = 0.5-2.5 nm). The analysis of alphaS's conformational landscapes and structural probabilities reveals that intermediate-sized SiO(2) nanoparticles (d = 1.2-1.4 nm) effectively stabilize the native intrinsically disordered conformations of alphaS (with domain sizes of 1-2 nm). In contrast, excessively large or small SiO(2) nanoparticles significantly enhance the likelihood of forming intramolecular beta-sheet domains within alphaS chains, a process that is critical for subsequent aggregation of alphaS. This study is of significance to the development of nanoparticles that stabilize desired protein conformations, which may pave the way for in vivo penetration and distribution of nanoparticles as well as biomedicine therapeutic interventions aimed at targeting alphaS aggregation.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质-纳米颗粒相互作用在众多生物技术和生物医学应用中至关重要。纳米颗粒尺寸的变化可以调节其与蛋白质及生物分子的表面相互作用，从而影响它们的构象和功能。为了实现与蛋白质结构域尺寸（约纳米级）相对应的纳米颗粒尺寸的精确控制，并建立纳米颗粒曲率与蛋白质构象变化之间的关系，我们进行了良驯元动力学 (well-tempered metadynamics) 模拟，以探索α-突触核蛋白 (alpha-synuclein, alphaS)——一种 intrinsically disordered protein (IDP)——吸附在不同尺寸（直径，d = 0.5-2.5 nm）的二氧化硅 (silicon dioxide, SiO(2)) 纳米颗粒上的二级结构变化和热力学特性。对alphaS构象景观和结构概率的分析揭示，中等尺寸的SiO(2)纳米颗粒（d = 1.2-1.4 nm）能有效稳定alphaS的天然 intrinsically disordered 构象（结构域尺寸为1-2 nm）。相反，过大或过小的SiO(2)纳米颗粒显著增加了alphaS链内形成分子内β-折叠结构域的可能性，这一过程对alphaS后续的聚集至关重要。本研究对于开发能稳定目标蛋白质构象的纳米颗粒具有重要意义，这可能为纳米颗粒在体内的渗透和分布以及针对alphaS聚集的生物医学治疗干预铺平道路。
